summary.zh: 新增声明式客户端驱动注册表（agent_pack_clients）：claude / codex / cursor 与只读的 claude-desktop 由数据声明，客户端名单与 --client 选项改为从注册表派生（既有输出不变）；新增只读命令 agenthelm clients 列出各驱动的检测结果、分发驱动类型与能力标志；预留 ~/.config/agenthelm/clients.d/*.json 用户声明文件，本版只校验，不执行其中任何内容，也不据此安装。
summary.en: Adds a declarative client-driver registry (agent_pack_clients): claude / codex / cursor and the read-only claude-desktop are declared as data, and the client lists and --client choices derive from it (existing output unchanged). New read-only command agenthelm clients lists each driver's detection result, distribution driver type and capability flags. Reserves user declarations in ~/.config/agenthelm/clients.d/*.json: this version only validates them, never executes anything in them and never installs from them.
